parsed.notes:
The explicit ideal-candidate qualifications in The Opportunity count as asks; its project descriptions and What You’ll Do do not. No qualification heading marks a whole section optional.
Large-scale dataset experience and big data techniques are optional because of the inline plus marker; neither has a matching taxonomy entry.
Statistics, machine learning and data mining are independently requested in the ideal-candidate paragraph. They therefore leave the later alternatives set, leaving deep learning without another groupable member.
The programming-language alternatives also include unmapped C; the modeling-tool alternatives also include unmapped Matlab.
The final candidate-appetite sentence is read literally as interest in applied AI, not specifically AI coding tools. This interpretation is flagged for review.
